    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700;900&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg:            #0d0d1a;
            --bg-secondary:  #111827;
            --bg-glass:      rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            --bg-glass-med:  rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            --border:        rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            --border-hover:  rgba(255,255,255,0.20);
            --text-primary:  #e8eaf6;
            --text-secondary:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
            --text-muted:    rgba(255,255,255,0.30);
            --accent:        #6366f1;
            --accent-glow:   rgba(99,102,241,0.45);
            --accent-hover:  #818cf8;
            --accent-light:  rgba(99,102,241,0.12);
            --cyan:          #06b6d4;
            --cyan-glow:     rgba(6,182,212,0.35);
            --success:       #10b981;
            --warning:       #f59e0b;
            --danger:        #ef4444;
            --radius-sm:  8px; --radius-md: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 24px;
            --font-body:  'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
            --font-title: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            --font-mono:  'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            --transition: 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
        }
        *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
        body { font-family: var(--font-body); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text-primary); line-height: 1.6; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; overflow-x: hidden; }
        a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
        ul { list-style: none; }
        img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

        /* Language */
        html.lang-de .t-en { display: none !important; }
        html.lang-en .t-de { display: none !important; }

        /* Nav */
        nav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 32px; height: 60px; background: rgba(13,13,26,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .nav-logo { font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 4px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--cyan)); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
        .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 28px; align-items: center; }
        .nav-links a { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: color var(--transition); }
        .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
        .lang-btn { display: flex; background: var(--bg-glass-med); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; }
        .lang-btn button { background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); transition: all var(--transition); }
        .lang-btn button.active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
        .btn-github { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; background: var(--bg-glass-med); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: all var(--transition); }
        .btn-github:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* Hero */
        .hero { position: relative; min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; }
        .hero-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: url('https://jarvis-ai.info/img/jarvis.jpg'); background-size: cover; background-position: center top; filter: brightness(0.35) saturate(0.8); z-index: 0; }
        .hero-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13,13,26,0.3) 0%, rgba(13,13,26,0.15) 40%, rgba(13,13,26,0.65) 80%, rgba(13,13,26,1) 100%); z-index: 1; }
        .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 780px; padding: 0 24px; }
        .hero-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 16px; background: rgba(99,102,241,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.35); border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-hover); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 28px; }
        .hero-eyebrow span.dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--success); border-radius: 50%; animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
        @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.85); } }
        .hero-title { font-family: var(--font-title); font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 10vw, 7rem); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 12px; line-height: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8eaf6 0%, var(--accent-hover) 40%, var(--cyan) 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .hero-tagline { font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.35rem); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px; font-weight: 300; }
        .hero-tagline strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }
        .hero-sub { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 40px; }
        .hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }
        .btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #4f46e5); border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: #fff; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition); box-shadow: 0 0 24px var(--accent-glow); }
        .btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 36px var(--accent-glow); }
        .btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; background: var(--bg-glass-med); border: 1px solid var(--border-hover); border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition); }
        .btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); transform: translateY(-2px); }
        .hero-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 36px; }
        .badge { padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--bg-glass); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

        /* Manifesto / Description */
        .manifesto { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13,13,26,0) 0%, rgba(99,102,241,0.04) 50%, rgba(13,13,26,0) 100%); border-top: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.12); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.12); padding: 72px 24px; }
        .manifesto-inner { max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
        .manifesto-lead { font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.15rem); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.85; }
        .manifesto-lead p { margin-bottom: 1.2em; }
        .manifesto-lead p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
        .manifesto-lead strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .manifesto-lead em { color: var(--accent-hover); font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; }

        /* Contribute */
        .contribute { background: rgba(99,102,241,0.04); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .contribute-inner { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
        .contribute-headline { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.1rem); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 16px; }
        .contribute-text { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.8; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto 36px; }
        .contribute-text strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .contribute-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; }
        .btn-contribute { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; transition: all var(--transition); }
        .btn-contribute-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #4f46e5); color: #fff; border: none; box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow); }
        .btn-contribute-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 32px var(--accent-glow); }
        .btn-contribute-secondary { background: var(--bg-glass-med); border: 1px solid var(--border-hover); color: var(--text-primary); }
        .btn-contribute-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); }

        /* Sections */
        section { padding: 80px 24px; }
        .container { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
        .section-title { text-align: center; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.4rem); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .section-sub { text-align: center; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 1rem; max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto 52px; }
        .section-sub strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .accent-text { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--cyan)); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }

        /* Features */
        .features-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
        .feature-card { position: relative; padding: 28px; background: var(--bg-glass); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); transition: all var(--transition); }
        .feature-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); background: var(--bg-glass-med); transform: translateY(-3px); }
        .feature-icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 14px; }
        .feature-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .feature-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; }
        /* Spotlight: stark hervorgehobene Feature-Karte (NEU) */
        .feature-card.spotlight {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            position: relative;
            padding: 34px 32px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.18) 0%, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 60%, rgba(99,102,241,0.06) 100%);
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.55);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(99,102,241,0.15), 0 18px 50px rgba(99,102,241,0.22);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .feature-card.spotlight::before {
            content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 12% 0%, rgba(99,102,241,0.25), transparent 55%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .feature-card.spotlight:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(99,102,241,0.85); }
        .feature-card.spotlight .feature-icon { font-size: 2.6rem; }
        .feature-card.spotlight .feature-title { font-size: 1.35rem; }
        .feature-card.spotlight .feature-desc { font-size: 0.95rem; max-width: 760px; }
        .feature-badge {
            position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 18px;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
            padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 20px;
            background: var(--accent); color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(99,102,241,0.5);
        }
        .feature-badge span.dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #fff; border-radius: 50%; animation: pulse 2s infinite; }

        /* OpenClaw */
        .openclaw-section { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.08) 0%, rgba(6,182,212,0.08) 100%); border-top: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.2); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(6,182,212,0.2); }
        .openclaw-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; align-items: center; }
        @media (max-width: 768px) { .openclaw-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; } }
        .openclaw-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.25), rgba(6,182,212,0.25)); border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.4); border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-hover); margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .openclaw-title { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.5vw, 2.2rem); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 16px; }
        .openclaw-desc { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.975rem; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 24px; }
        .openclaw-compare { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
        .compare-card { padding: 18px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .compare-card.before { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.06); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.2); }
        .compare-card.after  { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.06); border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.2); }
        .compare-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .compare-card.before .compare-label { color: var(--danger); }
        .compare-card.after  .compare-label { color: var(--success); }
        .compare-card ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
        .compare-card li { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-secondary); display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; }
        .compare-card li::before { content: "•"; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
        .compare-card.before li::before { color: var(--danger); }
        .compare-card.after  li::before { color: var(--success); }
        .openclaw-skills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 20px; }
        .skill-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; background: var(--bg-glass-med); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: all var(--transition); }
        .skill-pill:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* Screenshots */
        .screenshots-section { background: var(--bg-secondary); }
        .screenshot-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 32px; }
        .tab-btn { padding: 8px 20px; background: var(--bg-glass); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition); }
        .tab-btn.active, .tab-btn:hover { background: var(--accent-light); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text-primary); }
        .screenshot-panels > div { display: none; }
        .screenshot-panels > div.active { display: block; }
        .screenshot-frame { border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }
        .screenshot-frame img { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
        .screenshot-caption { text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 16px; }

        /* LLM */
        .llm-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-top: 32px; }
        .llm-card { padding: 20px; background: var(--bg-glass); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); text-align: center; transition: all var(--transition); }
        .llm-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); background: var(--bg-glass-med); }
        .llm-icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .llm-name { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; }
        .llm-models { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px; }

        /* Install */
        .install-card { background: var(--bg-glass); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); padding: 40px; max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; }
        .install-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 28px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 5px; }
        .install-tab { flex: 1; padding: 10px 16px; background: none; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius-md) - 3px); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition); font-family: var(--font-body); }
        .install-tab.active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
        .install-tab:hover:not(.active) { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: var(--text-primary); }
        .install-panel { display: none; }

            <p class="t-de">Die meisten KI-Assistenten sind Chatboxen: Du tippst, sie antworten – und das war's. <strong>Jarvis ist anders.</strong></p>
            <p class="t-en">Most AI assistants are chat boxes: you type, they respond – that's it. <strong>Jarvis is different.</strong></p>

            <p class="t-de">Jarvis ist ein <em>autonomer KI-Agent</em>, der auf deinem Linux-Server läuft und dort wirklich handelt. Er sieht deinen Desktop per Screenshot, bewegt die Maus, tippt Text, öffnet Programme und führt Bash-Befehle aus – genau wie ein Mensch, der vor dem Rechner sitzt. Kein Simulieren, kein „ich kann das leider nicht" – Jarvis arbeitet direkt auf deinem System.</p>
            <p class="t-en">Jarvis is an <em>autonomous AI agent</em> that runs on your Linux server and truly acts there. It sees your desktop via screenshot, moves the mouse, types text, opens programs and executes bash commands – just like a person sitting at the computer. No simulating, no "I'm sorry, I can't do that" – Jarvis works directly on your system.</p>

            <p class="t-de">Du gibst eine Aufgabe per Browser, WhatsApp oder API – Jarvis plant die Schritte, wählt die richtigen Werkzeuge und führt sie der Reihe nach aus. Schreibt Dateien, durchsucht deine Dokumente per <strong>RAG-Wissensdatenbank</strong>, steuert den Browser bis auf DOM-Ebene, sendet WhatsApp-Nachrichten und koordiniert bei komplexen Aufgaben mehrere spezialisierte Sub-Agenten gleichzeitig.</p>
            <p class="t-en">You give a task via browser, WhatsApp or API – Jarvis plans the steps, selects the right tools and executes them in sequence. Writes files, searches your documents via <strong>RAG knowledge base</strong>, controls the browser down to DOM level, sends WhatsApp messages and coordinates multiple specialized sub-agents simultaneously for complex tasks.</p>

            <p class="t-de">Welches KI-Modell dahintersteckt, bestimmst du. Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter, Ollama – oder jeder andere OpenAI-kompatible Anbieter. <strong>Lokale Modelle bleiben vollständig auf deiner Maschine</strong>; kein Byte deiner Daten verlässt den Server.</p>
            <p class="t-en">You decide which AI model powers it. Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter, Ollama – or any other OpenAI-compatible provider. <strong>Local models stay completely on your machine</strong>; not a single byte of your data leaves the server.</p>

<script>
    function setLang(lang) {
        document.documentElement.className = 'lang-' + lang;
        document.documentElement.lang = lang;
        document.getElementById('btn-de').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'de');
        document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
        try { localStorage.setItem('jarvis-lang', lang); } catch(e) {}
        document.title = lang === 'de'
            ? 'Jarvis – Autonomer KI Desktop-Agent'
            : 'Jarvis – Autonomous AI Desktop Agent';
    }
    (function() {
        try { const s = localStorage.getItem('jarvis-lang'); if (s === 'en') setLang('en'); } catch(e) {}
    })();

    function showTab(name, btn) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.screenshot-panels > div').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById('tab-' + name).classList.add('active');
        btn.classList.add('active');
    }

    function switchInstallTab(name, btn) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.install-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.install-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById('install-panel-' + name).classList.add('active');
        btn.classList.add('active');
    }

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        entries.forEach(e => {
            if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('visible'); observer.unobserve(e.target); }
        });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>
